rows.name: media
rows.content: One cell: optional picture (side image, or full-bleed background for background-image options) and/or a link to an .mp4/.webm video (video option).

rows.name: content
rows.content: One cell, rich text: optional eyebrow paragraph (e.g. Nubank), heading (h1), description paragraph.

rows.name: form
rows.content: One cell: label paragraph (signup card title), placeholder paragraph (e.g. Digite seu CPF), then a paragraph with the button link (text = button label, href = destination).

contentPattern.notes: Three single-cell rows (media, content, form); empty groups render as empty rows. With another row count the JS classifies rows by content: picture or video link without heading -> media, heading -> content, the rest -> form (first plain paragraph = label, second = placeholder, first link = button). Output: .hero-signup-media + .hero-signup-content (.hero-signup-text, form.hero-signup-form).

reuseGuidance: Use for any hero that includes the 'Digite seu CPF/CNPJ + Continuar' signup form. Pick a background-image option when the photo spans the whole hero; heroes without the form belong to hero-split or hero.
usageDescription: Page-top hero with eyebrow, headline, description and an account-signup card (title, CPF/CNPJ field, Continue button). Default/video/premium: image left, text + form right. Background-image options: full-bleed photo with headline left and the form card right. Purple: dark split with text + form left and image right (or below).
